seoTitle: Dump stations and LPG in Portugal: what to know before the winter
seoText1: Many motorhomes spend the winter in the Algarve, and more travel on along the Alentejo coast and through the centre. The questions on the road are practical ones: where can I empty the tanks, where is fresh water, and which fuel station has LPG, sold in Portugal as GPL.
seoText2: Portugal restricts overnight stays in motorhomes outside designated places, above all on the coast and in protected areas, so knowing where the caravan sites and campsites are matters more than in many countries. Check the local signs, and before you drive to a place, make sure it is still there: the map shows what has been recorded, and things change.
otherIntro: The same counts for Spain, and the services map for everywhere else you drive.
